from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,stat,sys
base=Path('/tmp/partydeck-android-adaptive-decode-ui-game-34540229407-v1/recordings/optimized-font-2.0')/sys.argv[1]
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
f=base/'FROZEN.json';assert sha(f)==sys.argv[2]
freeze=json.loads(f.read_text());assert freeze['status']=='complete'
m=base/'frame-manifest.json';manifest=json.loads(m.read_text());assert sha(m)==freeze['manifest_sha256']
assignment=json.loads(Path('/tmp/partydeck-adaptive-optimized-2.0-pixel-review-ui-shell-34540229407-v1/assignment.json').read_text())
original=next(r for r in assignment['recordings'] if r['id']==manifest['recording_id'])
assert manifest['original']['sha256']==original['sha256']
assert sha(Path(original['source_original']))==original['sha256']
assert manifest['validation_errors']==[]
expected=original['reported_source_frame_count'];assert manifest['source_frame_count']==manifest['retained_count']==expected
assert manifest['dimensions']==[1600,720] and manifest['lossless']
assert manifest['ffmpeg_exit_code']==0 and manifest['decode_invocations']==1
probe=json.loads((base/'media-probe.json').read_text());packets=probe['packets'];tb=probe['streams'][0]['time_base'];assert len(packets)==expected
seen=set();unique=[]
for n,(frame,packet) in enumerate(zip(manifest['frames'],packets)):
 p=Path(frame['path']);assert sha(p)==frame['sha256'];assert p.stat().st_size==frame['bytes'];assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o444
 assert frame['source_frame_index_zero_based']==n
 assert frame['time_base']==tb and frame['original_packet_pts']==int(packet['pts']) and frame['original_packet_dts']==int(packet['dts'])
 assert frame['source_showinfo']['n']==frame['converted_showinfo']['n']==n
 assert frame['source_showinfo']['pts']==frame['converted_showinfo']['pts']==int(packet['pts'])
 if frame['sha256'] not in seen: seen.add(frame['sha256']);unique.append(n)
for record in freeze['files']:
 p=base/record['path'];assert sha(p)==record['sha256'];assert p.stat().st_size==record['bytes'];assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o444
keys=('source_frame_index_zero_based','path','blob_path','sha256','bytes','width','height','original_packet_pts','time_base','media_time_exact','media_time_seconds')
print(json.dumps({'recording_id':manifest['recording_id'],'directory':str(base),'freeze_sha256':sha(f),'manifest_sha256':sha(m),'original':manifest['original'],'source_frame_count':expected,'unique_indices':unique,'frames':[{k:r[k] for k in keys} for r in manifest['frames']],'validation':'Original binding/hash, all frame hashes/sizes/read-only modes and frozen file pins verified. Each frame index and PTS independently compared with pinned packet and source/converted showinfo metadata.'}))
